program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (passable? r c v) (not (= v 5)))
    (define seen (make-hash))
    (define comps (list))
    (for ([p (in-list (grid-positions g))])
      (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
        (when (and (not (hash-has-key? seen p)) (passable? r c (at g r c)))
          (let ((comp (connected-region g r c passable?)))
            (for ([q (in-list comp)]) (hash-set! seen q #t))
            (set! comps (cons comp comps))))))
    (for/fold ([out (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 5) 5 0)))]) ([comp comps])
      (let ((seeds (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (or (= v 1) (= v 2) (= v 3)))) comp)))
        (if (= (length seeds) 1)
            (paint-cells out comp (at g (first (first seeds)) (second (first seeds))))
            out)))))
